name: frpm
definition: 按学年记录某所学校学生规模与免费/减价餐资格人数的统计信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 satscores 的辨析:frpm 记录的是按学年统计的餐费资格与在册人数,不是考试参与与成绩统计;两者虽都以 CDSCode 指向学校,但记录内容不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table frpm; provenance: direct source frpm
aliases: 免费及减价餐资格统计记录

name: satscores
definition: 按学校记录 SAT 考试参与人数与阅读、数学、写作平均成绩的统计信息记录。 Counterexample: 与 frpm 的辨析:satscores 记录考试参与与成绩,frpm 记录餐费资格与在册人数;两者都是按学校汇总的统计记录,但度量对象不同。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table satscores; provenance: direct source satscores

name: schools
definition: 由教育主管部门登记、具有唯一 CDSCode 标识并拥有地址与联系方式的教育机构。 Counterexample: 与 frpm、satscores 的辨析:schools 是学校实体本身,frpm 与 satscores 是描述该实体的统计信息记录,不是学校实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table schools; provenance: direct source schools

name: StateSpecialSchool
definition: A school operated as a State Special School, identified by EdOpsCode = 'SSS'.

name: VirtualSchool
definition: Schools that are exclusively virtual, indicated by Virtual = 'F'.

name: SATMathScore
definition: Average SAT Math score for a school.

name: Longitude
definition: Longitude coordinate of a school.

name: AdministratorEmail
definition: Email address of the school administrator, derived from AdmFName1 or other fields.
scope: schools where AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL

name: AverageWritingScore
definition: Average SAT Writing score for a school.

name: EnrollmentK12
definition: Enrollment count for grades K-12.
aliases: enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12

name: FreeMealCountK12
definition: Number of students eligible for free meals in grades K-12.

name: ElementarySchoolDistrict
definition: School district type classified as Elementary School District, indicated by DOC = 52.

name: OpenDate
definition: Date when the school opened.
scope: schools where OpenDate IS NOT NULL

name: CountyAlameda
definition: Schools located in Alameda County.

name: CitySanBernardino
definition: Schools located in San Bernardino City Unified district.
aliases: City of San Bernardino City Unified

name: CountySanBernardino
definition: Schools located in San Bernardino County.

name: CityMonterey
definition: Schools located in Monterey city.

name: CityFremont
definition: Schools located in Fremont city.

name: EnrollmentAges5to17
definition: Enrollment count for students aged 5 to 17.
aliases: students from the ages of 5 to 17

name: EligibleFreeRate
definition: Proportion of students eligible for free meals. Formula: FreeMealCountK12 / EnrollmentK12. Inputs: FreeMealCountK12 = frpm.Free Meal Count (K-12); EnrollmentK12 = frpm.Enrollment (K-12)

name: MonthlyAverageSchoolsOpened
definition: Average number of schools opened per month in a given year. Formula: COUNT(OpenDate in year) / 12. Inputs: OpenDate = schools.OpenDate WHERE OpenDate IS NOT NULL

name: AverageWritingScorePerSchool
definition: Average writing score for each school. Formula: AVG(AvgScrWrite). Inputs: AverageWritingScore = satscores.AvgScrWrite

name: NSLPProvisionStatus
definition: NSLP provision status for schools (e.g., Multiple Provision Types).

name: VirtualStatus
definition: Whether a school is virtual or not.

name: DOCType
definition: District type classification (e.g., Elementary School District).
